1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 e6 3.c3 d5 4.exd5 exd5 5.B.strategy: Puts the king in safety before the centre opens and keeps the pin on c6, so Black's knight stays tied. White completes development first and then takes the centre, leaving Black to untangle the pin.

Develops the bishop on an open diagonal, supports the c5-pawn and prepares to castle. Black answers the pin with quick development and keeps the centre pawns together, aiming for a position in which both sides develop smoothly.
